verdict.rationale: Core identity-verification actions (create applicant, start workflow, get SDK token, webhooks, OAuth) are documented as available via API/SDK, but the docs explicitly describe Workflow Studio as a 'no-code, drag-and-drop' tool and document-acceptance rules as configured 'in your Dashboard', with no stated API equivalent for building/editing workflows or document filters. Missing for 10: an API/CLI path to author or edit workflows and document-acceptance rules equivalent to the no-code Workflow Studio/Dashboard, and independent confirmation that all UI configuration surfaces are API-exposed.
